title: EvolveMAS: A Unified Self-Evolution Framework for Decentralized Multi-Agent Systems
abstract: arXiv:2610.34450v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Decentralized multi-agent systems (MAS) enable large language model agents to interact without centralized control. Agents need to adapt to other agents at test time and reuse accumulated experience to refine their interaction strategies for future interactions across cooperative, mixed-motive, and adversarial settings. However, existing approaches often develop adaptation mechanisms for particular interaction settings. This raises a central question: how can decentralized MAS support test-time adaptation and reliable experience reuse across interaction settings? We propose EvolveMAS, a unified self-evolution framework that supports experience-driven adaptation within and across episodes. EvolveMAS pairs each main agent with a dedicated MemoryAgent for test-time memory governance, which maintains isolated Structured Memory outside the main agent's reasoning context. translated_title: EvolveMAS：面向去中心化多智能体系统的统一自进化框架
translated_abstract: 去中心化多智能体系统（MAS）使大语言模型智能体能够在没有集中控制的情况下进行交互。智能体需要在测试时适应其他智能体，并复用积累的经验来完善其交互策略，以应对未来在合作、混合动机和对抗等多种环境下的交互。然而，现有方法往往针对特定交互环境开发适应机制。这就提出了一个核心问题：去中心化MAS如何支持跨交互环境的测试时适应和可靠的经验复用？我们提出了EvolveMAS，这是一个统一的自进化框架，支持基于经验的回合内和跨回合适应。EvolveMAS为每个主智能体配备一个专用的MemoryAgent进行测试时记忆治理，该MemoryAgent在主智能体的推理上下文之外维护隔离的结构化记忆。EvolveMAS将适应过程组织为两个互补的过程：（原文此处被截断）
tldr: EvolveMAS通过为每个主智能体配备专用MemoryAgent进行测试时记忆治理，在隔离的结构化记忆支持下，实现了去中心化多智能体系统在合作、混合动机和对抗等多种交互环境中的统一测试时适应与可靠经验复用。
en_tdlr: EvolveMAS is a unified self-evolution framework that pairs each main agent with a dedicated MemoryAgent for test-time memory governance, enabling decentralized multi-agent systems to achieve test-time adaptation and reliable experience reuse across cooperative, mixed-motive, and adversarial interaction settings.
